assets.prompt: Create an original finished background painting for a whimsical 1993 point-and-click graphic adventure, strongly inspired by the chunky, caricatured, goofy visual language of Day of the Tentacle. No photorealism, no fine texture, no pixel dithering, no 3D, no glossy modern rendering, no subtle atmospheric painting. Use lilac/purple walls, turquoise trim, apricot/orange wooden floor, pale custard highlights, lime-green CRT phosphor, and deep plum shadows. Slightly spooky, ridiculous, warmly inviting. Original Montreal university computer science research lab; NO people, NO characters, NO user interface, NO captions, NO legible text, NO brand logos. Landscape exactly 3:2 aspect ratio, image fills edge to edge. Preserve this specific navigable adventure-room layout: left wall a giant crooked cork NOTICEBOARD, occupying x1%-20%, y2%-32%, with a few large skewed paper notices and abstract film illustrations, no words. Below and to its right, a squat wooden desk with legs leaning at unreasonable angles, an enormous bulging beige CRT COMPUTER around x11%-27%, y33%-52%, green screen, giant silly keyboard. An absurd leaning stack of RESEARCH PAPERS on the desk at x28%-44%, y39%-52%. Upper middle x43%-68% is a crooked arched WINDOW overlooking simplified Montreal brick rooftops and one green copper dome under a salmon pink sky; a pot plant with enormous droopy leaves. RIGHT REAR a tall skewed purple/teal EXIT DOOR around x74%-89%, y4%-61%, large readable brass handle, trapezoidal frame with a small absurd crack at top. Far RIGHT foreground a chunky cream RECORD PLAYER with an open clear angular dust cover and big black record, atop a warped walnut credenza at x87%-100%, y48%-65%; three giant record sleeves underneath. The lower 38% of the scene is broad clear orange wooden FLOOR with enormous uneven boards, keep x40%-80%, y65%-96% uncluttered for a game character to walk there. Add a comically giant mug, one sagging bookcase, a peculiar desk lamp, and a coiled cable, but favour a handful of big clear goofy props over tiny clutter. The scene should be immediately recognisable as a funny hand-painted cartoon adventure room and match a character with a large head and stubby heroic stance. Strong intentionally art-directed asymmetric composition. Original artwork, no recreation of any existing game's actual room or characters.

Use the supplied tattoo photos as shape/colour reference: flowing teal/blue-grey waves and cloud shapes, sperm whale upper arm, squid and anchor forearm, muted ink/teal/rust accents. Simplify to large cartoon tattoo motifs that read at game scale. The anatomical RIGHT arm remains UNTATTOOED. Only a SMALL TIGER FORELEG / PAW and grey-blue Japanese clouds peek over the shirt's V-neck; NO tiger head or face above the collar and most of the chest design stays under the shirt. Keep the owner fully clothed. Whole figure from hair to soles visible, centered with modest even margins. Preserve native transparency, opaque flat colours inside the figure, fully transparent outside silhouette. No floor shadow, halo, background haze, panel or watermark. Make a playful believable game adventurer who resembles these photos.
